newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala approves 25 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Ayala approves 25 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Philippine conglomerate Ayala Corp said on Wednesday its board had approved a 25 percent stock dividend to shareholders on record May 15.
"The 25 percent stock dividend will be presented for ratification by stockholders during Ayala's annual stockholders meeting scheduled on April 18," the firm said in a statement.
The Ayala board had approved the dividends, worth 1.65 billion pesos, to be paid to shareholders on or before June 30 this year.
Last year, the company declared a 50 percent stock dividend to shareholders on record August 15, 1996, records at the Philippine Stock Exchange showed.
